target.selection: first 32 by (SHA256(UTF8(str(seed)+":"+existing_group_id)), existing_group_id), after role and overlap validation
target.playback: original manifest order, retaining known video relative order
target.grouping: use existing content groups; absent group IDs require an explicitly justified registration rule before selection

arms.N: source standard BN; no prompt or adaptation
arms.B: native A + 0.1 * original full K=4 source proxy region loss

H.normalization: gamma * (z - frozen source_mean) / sqrt(frozen source_var + eps) + beta on every original AdaBN layer in adaptation and prediction
H.loss: native warm-up reference construction, sample count, estimators, reduction dimensions, detach, epsilon, bn_loss and task layer aggregation; computed from H own activations

native.memory_capacity_semantics: retain native observable behavior, including capacity 41

io.preprocessing: reuse confirmed source-pilot task-specific RGB and final grid protocol
io.polyp_encoding: foreground>127; no legacy bilinear GT substitution
io.target_masks: independent evaluator only after final prediction is fixed
io.source_whitelist: unchanged; separate target registration and reader required
io.online_step_input: current image only; no future images, domain identity or boundary signals

lifecycle.fresh_start: each task and arm, independent model/prompt/Adam/memory/counter/RNG from same source state and seed
lifecycle.source_to_target: release all source hosts, create fresh target hosts

budget.identity_forwards: additional N/H identity checks with zero optimizer calls; count separately
budget.other_compute: separate actual model/prompt/proxy forwards, proxy images, backwards, optimizer calls and pushes

metrics.fundus_task: equal-domain mean of within-domain OD/OC channel macro
metrics.assd: lower is better; pairwise common defined cohort; undefined counts; no OD/OC macro ASSD; adverse tail is increasing side
metrics.segments: first 5 domain visits versus remainder descriptive only

screening.meaning: research resource filter only; no significance or clinical threshold; no automatic follow-up

private_output.append: validate identity, finite values and lifecycle before append, flush and fsync; completion only after exact coverage and final full source state verification

hard_stops: unresolved identity or role overlap or known patient/video conflict
fewer than 32 valid content groups in any domain
unsupported environment or failed CPU tests
failure: preserve completed arms and successful prefix; record private location and actual counts; nonzero execution exit, no skip, substitution, continuation or automatic rerun; poor scientific scores alone do not stop the fixed flow
independent_recompute: CPU only, registry order, exact 104 source and 896 target records, channels/lifecycle/completions/source state, actual 52+672 updates plus 106 smoke, compare saved aggregates

interpretation.target_prior_exposure: historical full-target experiments documented; no untouched-final-test claim
